authority: Removes obsolete vector projections under exact authority checks; does not establish complete deletion, influence removal, or semantic retrieval quality.
failure_or_lesson: A read-time filter can keep obsolete points from being returned while leaving old vectors in the index. Cleanup must follow authority and still cannot replace read-time validation because the planes are not atomic.
goal: Remove obsolete derived vector points after a governed claim correction while preserving XTDB as the authority.
notes: The trace records the selected-backend result, not embedding quality or completed deletion/influence removal.
procedure: Bind each indexed point to the claim authority namespace. On correction, scan only points bearing that claim ID, compare each to XTDB current version, projection, and evidence relations, delete obsolete IDs after the scan, and retain read-time authority checks for lag or races. Retrying the cleanup removes nothing further.
validation: Real-backend run 36572682119 passed Qdrant/XTDB/KurrentDB integration; it pruned obsolete and forged points, preserved the current point, and was idempotent.
